selection: First two non-empty records in original JSON order whose individual compact JSON serialization is at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes; complete records, no chunk truncation.
collection: Benchmark Wikipedia URLs fetched using Jina Reader; Markdown stripped using Mistune, according to the original collection script.
chunking: The source is the 512-token chunk artifact. The original chunking script uses the Qwen3-Reranker-4B tokenizer, non-overlapping token windows and a greater-than-50-character filter.
purpose: Small service smoke-test sample, not an evaluation split.
